Axiom:
A ticket group is not "audited" until the CLI has recorded ONE durable group-completion receipt on the owning spec. Audit itself stays cross-ticket, post-close, read-only, and ephemeral-on-pass (`AX_AUDIT_HOOK`, `AX_EPHEMERAL_OUTPUT`, `AX_REOPEN_ROUNDS_IN_TICKET`) — this axiom does NOT persist findings and does NOT touch ticket files; it persists only the durable FACT "this group was audited, verdict V, at git-ref R".
Enforcement point is the GROUP-COMPLETION boundary, never `sdd-log close` (close precedes audit — requiring a receipt at close would deadlock). Once the group's LAST ticket is `[x] DONE` and the read-only `sdd-audit` has returned, the execute orchestrator — never the read-only audit worker — runs `sdd-log audit-receipt `. The CLI re-resolves the group via `resolveAuditGroup`, REFUSES unless every re-derived member is `[x] DONE`, binds the fact to the current HEAD ref, and writes a single CLI-owned `SDD_AUDIT_RECEIPT` block on the owning spec through the atomic proven-file primitive — so a pasted block cannot forge it.
A reopen (a new Round on any member) invalidates the receipt until re-audit: `sdd-check` re-derives the group and its member Round-count signature, and emits `SDD_GROUP_AUDIT_MISSING` when a group whose members are all DONE has no valid, non-stale receipt. The check keys off the WHOLE group being complete, never a lone ticket's `[x]`.
